project_title: SIX-SCENE INTERACTIVE SCRAPBOOK PORTFOLIO — Zaiba Muskan D.M. (Wispr Flow Hiring Challenge)

design_philosophy.core_aesthetic: Warm espresso scrapbook × editorial portfolio × handmade creative journal
design_philosophy.tone: Personal, warm, artistic, slightly imperfect, editorial, tactile, cinematic, elegant, technically polished
forbidden_patterns: No glassmorphism or muddy gray transparency
No neon lighting or cyberpunk glows
No standard long single-page infinite scrolling (must use full-screen scene replacement)
No Inter font for main or sub headlines
No raw input tags or unstyled native select elements

semantic_usage.main_background: Espresso #29150F with shared leather/suede texture overlay
semantic_usage.small_details: Muted Gold #C9A36B for tape edges, subtle stars, icon accents

torn_paper_edges.css_technique: mask-image: radial-gradient / polygon clip-path with subtle irregular zig-zag (e.g., polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 98% 97%, 95% 100%, 90% 98%, 82% 100%, 75% 97%, 68% 99%, 60% 96%, 52% 100%, 45% 97%, 38% 99%, 30% 96%, 22% 100%, 15% 97%, 8% 99%, 0% 96%)) or SVG path mask filter for warm parchment elements
torn_paper_edges.paper_texture_overlay: repeating radial dot / SVG feTurbulence noise filter at opacity 0.04-0.07

masking_tape_strips.styling: Semi-transparent warm beige/muted gold (#C9A36B / #E5C69B with opacity 0.75-0.85), subtle drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)), rotated -3deg to 4deg, placed on corners or top edges of parchment cards
masking_tape_strips.border_edges: Jagged/crinkled end cuts using clip-path: polygon(4% 0%, 96% 0%, 100% 50%, 96% 100%, 4% 100%, 0% 50%)

card_rotations.desktop: Randomized subtle rotation range -2.2deg to +2.2deg across cards to mimic hand-pinned album elements
card_rotations.mobile: -0.5deg to +0.5deg for tight screen alignment and tap accuracy

shadows.card_hover_transform: transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(0deg) scale(1.015); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

doodles_and_connectors.arrows: Hand-drawn SVG path arrows with soft pink stroke (#D98B9C / #F0A6B8) and stroke-dasharray animation
doodles_and_connectors.dotted_connector_lines: SVG dash array lines (dash: 4 4) connecting experience cards in Scene 2 and build stages in Scene 4
doodles_and_connectors.underlines: Pink organic hand-drawn underline SVG under key section titles and active nav items
doodles_and_connectors.stars_and_accents: Small 4-point doodle stars and handwritten circle annotations in muted gold (#C9A36B) or dusty rose (#D98B9C)

shared_background.base_layer: Single fixed container sharing an espresso suede/leather texture background image across all six scenes

css_properties.overlay: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(41, 21, 15, 0.82) 0%, rgba(27, 16, 13, 0.88) 100%) for high readability

navigation_bar.position: Fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 h-16 sm:h-20 px-4 sm:px-8 lg:px-12 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#29150F]/70 border-b border-[#4A291C]/50 flex items-center justify-between

logo.handwritten_accent: Dusty rose doodle star next to name

link_styling.active: text-[#FFF2DB] font-semibold relative after:content-[''] after:absolute after:-bottom-1 after:left-0 after:right-0 after:h-[2px] after:bg-[#D98B9C] after:rounded-full

cta_button.label: Let's Talk
cta_button.hover: bg-[#D98B9C] text-[#FFF2DB] shadow-lg shadow-[#D98B9C]/20 transform scale-105

animation_properties.enter: opacity 0 -> 1, transform: translateY(24px) scale(0.985) -> translateY(0) scale(1.0)

navigation_controls.mouse_wheel: One full gesture = increment/decrement scene. Debounced with a 750ms lock-out timer to prevent accidental double scene skews
navigation_controls.keyboard_navigation: ArrowUp / ArrowLeft -> Prev Scene; ArrowDown / ArrowRight / Space -> Next Scene; Home -> Scene 1; End -> Scene 6
navigation_controls.touch_gestures: Mobile vertical swipe listener with threshold > 45px
navigation_controls.scene_indicator: Fixed right side vertical dot navigation (6 subtle parchment dots with active dusty pink highlight ring)

general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attribute_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, cards, nav items, tabs) MUST include a kebab-case role-based data-testid attribute. Examples: data-testid="nav-link-home", data-testid="cta-lets-talk-button", data-testid="scene-2-card-1", data-testid="download-resume-button"
general_ui_ux_guidelines.file_extension_rule: The project uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components, NOT TypeScript (.tsx) files. Ensure guidelines reference .js syntax.

accessibility.apca_wcag_compliance: All parchment text uses Ink #241712 on Parchment #F1D9B5 (contrast ratio > 11:1). All dark panel text uses Cream #FFF2DB on Dark Coffee #4A291C (contrast ratio > 9.5:1).
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum touch target size of 44px x 44px on mobile viewports for all buttons, dots, and links.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling card floating tilts and instant scene jump without transition lag.
